comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs. trigger_segment must exactly match a segment name in data/route.json. Fired once per session as the player enters that road segment for the first time. lat/lon are reference coordinates (not used by the engine). needs_owner_review: true where OSM data may be imprecise — the owner's lived knowledge of the route is authoritative.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The iconic strip — sea on both sides, airport behind you, the Blue Mountains ahead

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Eastern gateway into Kingston, at the foot of the Palisadoes causeway

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Eastern Kingston community, named for the historic Rockfort mineral baths and fort

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community in east Kingston — spiritual home of Rastafari drumming; Count Ossie's legacy

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's modern business and hotel district — Emancipation Park is here

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The crossroads of Kingston — halfway between Port Royal and Spanish Town in colonial times

communities.name: Spanish Town
communities.note: Jamaica's historic capital, founded by the Spanish in 1534 — Old King's House is here

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Gateway to the gorge — the Rio Cobre runs alongside, and Flat Bridge is famous for its lack of railings

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: "Carry mi ackee go a Linstead market" — the song names this famous market town

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small St. Catherine town on the climb toward Moneague, known for the JAMALCO alumina plant nearby

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Hill-country crossroads where St. Ann meets St. Catherine — the road north opens up here

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Legendary roadside cookshop strip — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival. Pull over or regret it.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: 3 km canopy road through giant ferns and bamboo on the descent into Ocho Rios

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: St. Ann's tourist capital — Dunn's River Falls and the end of the road await
